audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. Olaf's W is called omnivamp (Riot: attack speed plus a shield; the life steal is the passive). Spirit Cleave is treated as pure damage when Riot's text says it also shields Yone, scaled by champions hit. And whys[5]/spikes[2] claim the axe slow 'shuts off his Q-dash spacing entirely' — Undertow slows and shreds armour, it does not deny a dash.
audit.why: Each one changes how a player commits: he expects to heal through the trade, he under-rates the shield he is punching into, and he thinks a landed axe makes Mortal Steel unusable.
audit.corrected: W shields you; Spirit Cleave shields him on a 14s cooldown; the slow makes his dash unrewarding, it does not disable it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound is the tracked ability of the whole page and its cooldown is never given.
audit.why: 22/19/16/13/10s is the punish window the entire lane plan rests on — at rank 1 that is over 20 seconds of a Yone with no escape from an axe-slow all-in, and it shrinks to 10s by the time he has items.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound 22s at rank 1, 10s maxed; Mortal Steel 4s; Fate Sealed 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Olaf the two-item row while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Yone reclaims the game there, and marks 4-5 and first item as Skill against a packet chart of Olaf for both.
audit.why: The one row Yone genuinely owns is the row currently awarded to Olaf, on a 9/10 carry threat.
audit.corrected: Olaf Levels 1 through first item; Yone at two-plus items.

audit.why: 54.78% supports an Olaf-favoured lane; note the packet's own games figure (1632) differs from the brief header (1725), which is a data question, not a text one.

edits.before: Axe-reset perma-slow plus W-omnivamp out-sustain his spirit-cleave short trades.
edits.after: Axe resets perma-slow him while W's shield eats Spirit Cleave, which is only 14s.

edits.before: Black Cleaver / Bramble make your slow constant and shut off his Q-dash spacing entirely.
edits.after: Black Cleaver and Bramble make the slow constant, so his 4s Mortal Steel dash buys nothing.

edits.before: Black Cleaver / Bramble — perma-slow with axe resets shuts off his Q-dash spacing, your most oppressive lane point.
edits.after: Black Cleaver and Bramble — chained axe resets mean his two-stack Mortal Steel dash never buys him spacing.

edits.before: Yone's window: full crit + E-rewind let him reset every trade and outscale your flat true damage.
edits.after: Yone's window: full crit and a 10s Soul Unbound let him reset every trade and outscale your damage.

edits.before: Yone is genuinely even at level 1, but you spike harder fast. Land Q to slow him, walk up, and weave an auto — by 2-3 you add E for a guaranteed true-damage chunk he can't match before his Q stacks or W damage ramp. Don't whiff Q into his dash window: if he Q-dashes you, your slow misses and he resets free. Bait his E spirit-rewind early, because once it's down he has no way out of your all-in.
edits.after: Yone is genuinely even at level 1, but you spike harder fast. Land Undertow to slow him, walk up, and weave an auto — by 2-3 you add Reckless Swing for a true-damage chunk he cannot match before Mortal Steel stacks or Spirit Cleave ramps. Don't throw the axe into his two-stack dash. Bait Soul Unbound early: it is 22s at rank 1, and once it is gone he has no way out of your all-in.

edits.before: This is your takeover. Your passive ramps attack speed as you take his cleave damage, W-omnivamp heals it back, and chained axe-resets keep him perma-slowed so he can't kite. At 6, Ragnarok is the key beat — it cleanses his R knockup mid-air, so when he ults to airborne-combo you, you stay unstoppable and keep swinging. With Black Cleaver or Bramble your slow is constant and his Q-dash spacing collapses. Force every all-in in this window.
edits.after: This is your takeover. Your passive ramps attack speed and life steal as you take his cleave damage, W's shield eats the rest, and chained axe resets keep him perma-slowed. At 6 Ragnarok is the key beat — press it as he ults so Fate Sealed's pull does nothing and you keep swinging. Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1: the moment he spends it, he has no way out of your all-in. Force every fight in this window.

edits.before: Force short all-ins at 2-6 where W-omnivamp and your ramping passive out-sustain his spirit-cleave trades
edits.after: Force short all-ins at 2-6 where W's shield and your ramping passive beat his Spirit Cleave trades

edits.before: Use Q-dash and E spirit-rewind to dodge your axe and reset to safe range between trades
edits.after: Use the Mortal Steel dash and Soul Unbound's snap-back to reset to safe range between trades

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Stick to him. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and snaps him back to his body. Bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave is 14s and shields him — trade after it, not into it.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Stick to him. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1, and it snaps him back to his body. Bait it, then commit. - Spirit Cleave: 14s, and it shields him. - Fate Sealed: 120s at rank 1 — his one real engage.

notes: The claim that Ragnarok 'cleanses his R knockup mid-air' was reworded to the safer form (press it as he ults) rather than deleted — Fate Sealed is a pull, not a knockup, per Riot's text, and Ragnarok's text says only 'immune to disables'. whys[4] and spikes[1] still carry the mid-air knockup phrasing; correcting them needs a call on whether Ragnarok stops the Fate Sealed pull, which the kits do not answer. Chart flips are matched full/content pairs.
